review_text: This app is very poor and has extremely limited features. Basically, it just puts a bad wrinkle filter and bushy hair on a photo, no AI or face sculpting. I was trying to amuse my 5 yr old, she said 'this app sucks' and she was right.

Recommend not to install what I think is a useless app, it shows a photo that you decorate with silly moustaches, glasses etc on.  Total waste of time, I've already uninstalled it.  You asked me to update my review of this app, sorry, my opinion is unchanged, I can do that in photoshop without installing this app.
Tried the app for 3 people and it only added some wrinkles and that's all

This app is a joke.  It did not make me look one year older, instead it just made me look super wrinkled.  In its favor though, it asked for permissions during the install process and didn't freak out when I only wanted to get pictures already taken.

Not a big selection and can't save images to my phone. Meaning that my phone won't save the images, which is ok now as l have navigated a similar one u have and found how to use it, but still not a lot of options on the app.
